set.rappels: About 10 double-rope rappels (two 60 m ropes) down the X Couloir: four off pickets you place, one off a rock sling, five off existing slings on rock horns
set.rappel_count_note: One documented descent, a second descent of the couloir, made ten double-rope rappels: four off pickets the party placed, one off a sling around a rock, and five off slings already on rock horns lower in the gully. Carry two ropes, pickets you are willing to leave, and spare cord. In good snow, parties downclimb some of the face instead.
